tested_object: Temporal robustness on March 2020 of the exact R6-style January-fitted 64h N0 ridge(lambda=1) one-hour relation and matched shuffled-target controls

research_series_policy.adaptation_rationale: R3-R6 repeatedly showed a weak positive one-hour 64h-N0 linear point relation on February without robust qualification; R7 freezes that simple surface and tests whether the point relation persists on already-exposed March development without any refit or model change
research_series_policy.if_robustness_gate_passes: promote only a temporal-robustness candidate hypothesis for a new future qualification/transfer design; do not claim confirmation
research_series_policy.if_gate_misses: do_not_rescue_R7; record temporal robustness not established for this exact probe

adaptations_made_after_exposure: R7 robustness question selected after observing R0/R1 March results and R3-R6 Jan-Feb diagnostics

claims.tested_object: January-fitted 64h N0 ridge(lambda=1) true-target probe versus eight matched shuffled-January-target probes evaluated on March 2020

estimand.robustness_rule: both one-sided 95% day-block bootstrap lower bounds > 0

claims.estimator: January feature standardization + closed-form ridge(lambda=1), March Pearson correlation, eight matched shuffled-January-target controls, paired day-block bootstrap
claims.replication_unit: UTC calendar day; 4096 bootstrap replicates are uncertainty draws, not independent scientific replicates
validity_prerequisites: January fit window and 64h N0/ridge semantics match R6 reference configuration
no February or March target fitting
February may enter only as strictly prior context for early-March states
same January target permutations used for matched controls
March consists of 31 complete UTC day blocks
credible_alternatives: March was already inspected in R0/R1 and is not independent confirmation
a robustness miss may reflect temporal regime shift rather than absence of any market relation
a robustness pass may reflect adaptation history and requires a separate fresh/independent design before qualification
linear one-hour accessibility is only one narrow relation family
authority_scope: may support or fail to support temporal robustness of this exact January-fitted 64h linear point relation on adaptively reused March development
may prioritize a future independent robustness/transfer experiment if the gate passes

composition_dependencies.ref: R0 March causal context carryover rule
February weak point relation may persist into March

evaluation.causal_context_history_carryover: may use trailing February hourly bars strictly before each March consequence

probe.feature_standardization: January fit mean/population-std; drop std<=1e-12; freeze for March

uncertainty_protocol.method: paired bootstrap of 31 UTC March calendar-day blocks
